title: Grass+ no twigs
description: This resourcepack will delete twigs and pebbles from Grass+ resourcepack.
body:
### Note: 
- this resourcepack requires [Grass+ resourcepack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/grass+) (put my on top of it)
- this resourcepack does NOT add anything on its own, it does delete rocks and pebbles from the Grass+ resourcepack
